details: Page 100 is a Ceefax-style teletext service rebuilt as a static web app. No backend, no keys, no tracking.
News comes from the Hacker News API when online, with bundled headlines as fallback so the page never blanks.
Weather uses Open-Meteo geocoding and forecast data. Press Enter on page 200 and type a city name.
Sport, finance and TV guide pages ship with fallback data and try keyless live sources where available.
Type any three-digit page number. 100-899 are valid; unregistered numbers show a not-found page.
Sub-pages cycle every five seconds. Press H to hold, arrow keys to step through them by hand.
The 8-colour teletext palette, double-height headers and 2x3 mosaic blocks are rendered in plain CSS.
Built with Kiro specs, steering and tasks under .kiro, plus a vanilla-JS implementation with no build step.
